high_level_smoke.command: uv run --project moli-cdp-smoke moli-cdp-smoke --group network --group workers --group websocket --group fetch-runtime-teardown --group network-body-cache

windows_fixture_regressions.root_cause: Windows accepted sockets inherited the nonblocking listener mode; the synchronous fixture treated WouldBlock as connection closure.
windows_fixture_regressions.fix: Set accepted scripted-server sockets to blocking mode. No production retry was added.

windows_shutdown_regressions.root_cause: Classic shutdown acknowledged command receipt before actor and renderer cleanup; process-exit AWS-LC random-state cleanup could then deadlock with Windows thread-local destructors.
windows_shutdown_regressions.fix: Await shared actor completion and return its cookie commit after owner cleanup; remove the early shutdown response channel.
windows_shutdown_regressions.red_regression: session shutdown returned before its owner finished cleanup

smoke_server_cleanup.note: Fixture interruption, not used as proof of normal process exit. Normal exit is verified by the twenty unassisted test-process repetitions.

windows_shutdown_regressions.excluded_run: The earlier full workspace run required debugger intervention to end the stuck process and is not counted as an unassisted pass.
